title: Sri Pushparama Vihara, Ratmalana
displaytitle: Sri Pushparama Vihara, Ratmalana

titles.display: Sri Pushparama Vihara, Ratmalana

extract: Sri Pushparama Vihara is a historic Buddhist temple situated in Ratmalana, Western province, Sri Lanka. It is located at Sri Dharmarama junction on the Colombo-Galle main road. The temple has been formally recognised by the Government as an archaeological site in Sri Lanka. The designation was declared on 23 February 2007 under the government Gazette number 1486.
